name: SiteLeads
author: Extend Themes

sections.description:
SiteLeads is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help website owners increase their conversion rates by providing visitors with easy ways to contact them. The plugin adds floating contact buttons that remain visible as users scroll through your site.

Key Features:

  • Multiple Contact Methods – Add phone, email, and WhatsApp contact options
  • Floating/Sticky Design – Buttons stay visible while users browse your site
  • Mobile Responsive – Optimized for all device sizes
  • Customizable Appearance – Control colors, positions, and styling
  • Easy Setup – Simple configuration through WordPress admin
  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on site performance

Perfect for:

  • Business websites
  • Service providers
  • E-commerce stores
  • Landing pages
  • Local businesses
  • Any site wanting to increase lead generation

The plugin helps bridge the gap between website visitors and business owners by making it incredibly easy for potential customers to get in touch.

Source Files

📂 GitHub Repository
sections.installation:
1. Go to WP Admin -> Plugins -> Add New -> Upload plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the SiteLeads settings page in your WordPress admin
  4. Configure your contact information and customize the appearance
  5. Save your settings and view your site to see the floating contact buttons
